display.purpose: Hero headlines on brand surfaces; one gradient phrase max.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, category slugs, chip labels — uppercase, wide tracking.

mono.purpose: Status indicators and machine-flavored accents only.

body.purpose: All running text on both worlds.

components.name: Primary Button (light pages)
components.description: Incumbent BEM c-button--primary: legacy blue fill on light chrome.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; background-color: #1a8cff; color: #ffffff; font-size: 16px; line-height: 18px; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #0066cc; } .ds-btn-primary:active { position: relative; top: 1px; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #121212; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ruby Pill
components.description: Filled ruby pill — year/ecosystem marker on brand surfaces; the CTA shape on obsidian.
components.css: .ds-pill-ruby { display: inline-block; background: #cc342d; color: #ffb4ab; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: -0.005em; padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Stat Chip
components.description: Semi-transparent raised chip with colored left border; label whispers, value speaks.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; background: rgba(28, 32, 38, 0.75); border-left: 3px solid #cc342d; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-chip-label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #969798; } .ds-chip-value { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; color: #dfe2eb; }

components.name: Status Indicator
components.description: Mono uppercase status with colored dot; bottom-right texture element on brand surfaces.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #dfe2eb; } .ds-status-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #22c55e; }

components.name: Obsidian Hero Field
components.description: The brand-surface backdrop: 135deg obsidian gradient with ruby grid-dot texture and ambient glows.
components.html: Find out what you actually have
components.css: .ds-obsidian-field { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a0e14 0%, #10141a 55%, #1a0a2e 100%); background-color: #0a0e14; padding: 48px 32px; background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(204, 52, 45, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 48px 48px; } .ds-hero { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 40px; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: #ffffff; margin: 0; } .ds-hero-grad { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #cc342d, #a855f7); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; }

narrative.overview: A dark technical blueprint: authoritative, precise, sophisticated. The brand surface is deep obsidian shading toward violet, lit by two inks — Ruby red (the JetThoughts mark) and neon purple — with engineering texture: grid-dot backdrops, stat chips, mono status indicators. The repository carries two coexisting layers: JetVelocity (brand world, normative for new brand/conversion surfaces) and the legacy light page chrome (BEM c-* components, being consolidated by the 2509 CSS migration).
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian dark + ruby/purple dual-ink accents (brand surfaces)
Engineering texture: chips, pills, mono status dots, grid-dot backdrops
Space Grotesk 800 display over quiet system-ui body
Flat surfaces; depth via tone and glow, not shadow stacks
Light legacy chrome persists on existing pages — two worlds, never mixed mid-page

rules.name: The Ruby Ink Rule
rules.body: Ruby #cc342d is the brand accent ink, used sparingly and structurally (pills, gradient starts, borders) — its rarity is its authority. It is never a background wash.

rules.name: The Never-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: On obsidian surfaces body text is #dfe2eb, never #ffffff — pure white is reserved for display headlines.

rules.name: The One-Gradient-Word Rule
rules.body: The ruby→purple gradient belongs to at most one emphasized display phrase per surface; everything else stays solid.

dos: Do use ruby (#cc342d) as the structural accent — pills, borders, gradient starts — on both worlds.
Do keep body text #dfe2eb on obsidian and #121212 on paper.
Do reuse the BEM c-* components on light pages and the chip/pill/status vocabulary on brand surfaces before inventing new patterns.
Do hold the two-ink limit: ruby leads, purple partners, cyan only as a tertiary informational accent.
donts: Don't mix the worlds mid-page — a surface is either obsidian-brand or light-chrome.
Don't carry legacy blue (#1a8cff) onto obsidian surfaces.
Don't stack box-shadows for depth; use tone and glow.
Don't use pure white body text on dark, or gradient more than one display phrase per surface.
Don't invent a third accent hue; the palette is closed.
